items.title: Gordon Lorraine — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: But I sit and I listen to them, and I remember them, and sometimes they become leaders. Lots of times, from out of a group comes a leader. Brad Mehldau.

ctx.x: I can’t remember his last... Anyway, he was wonderful, and I do want him to come back. He was a revelation to me. I mean, he can do all the crazy things that he’s capable of, but he doesn’t do them at the club. Some artists can perform in any way they think they atmosphere demands of them or not. No, he was great. No, I hear lots of new young men. They’re usually in a band with someone. A leader will come in with a trumpet and a trombone, or a sax, who I don’t really know. Live recordings at the Vanguard are very special in the collection of jazz. How do you determine who gets to record at the Vanguard?
